text: かわいい　ポケモン　たちに　ごあいさつを　させるわ！

structure.jp: かわいい　ポケモン　たちに
ごあいさつを　させるわ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: たちに　ごあいさつを　させる
patterns.explanation: させる is the 'make someone do' form of する, and に shows who is made to do it. ポケモン　たちに　ごあいさつを　させる = 'I'll have my Pokémon say hello'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives it a soft, feminine tone. させるわ = 'I'll have them do it'.
